  "The licensed guideline corpus contains recommendations for melanoma under initial local management, even though the case was classified as MISC.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for recommendation 1 is 100 % (21/21).",
  "The criteria driving the 6‑point score are: blue_whitish_veil (present, 2 points), vascular_structures (dotted, 2 points), dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point), and regression_structures (combinations, 1 point).",
  "Blue‑whitish veil is defined as confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze.",
  "Dotted vascular structures are small, round, red or brown vessels.",
  "Irregular dots/globules are varied in size and unevenly distributed.",
  "Regression structures are white scar‑like areas, blue peppering, or both."
